{{Top|leg}}
A '''power fence generator''' was a [[Power generator/Legends|generator]] used to provide power to a [[Power fence/Legends|power fence]]. They were legal on some [[Planet/Legends|planets]], but, by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Grand Protector/Legends|Grand Protector]], [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]], had banned such technology for some provinces on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], such as the [[Chekkoo Province]]. 

Used power fence generators in working order could run from 1,000 to 3,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
